admission.justification: Persisting the call under a minted UUID before creation prevents an interrupted launch allocating a second role on retry.

applicability: Saved workspace/agent launch operations after catalog validation.
exclusions: Pre-launch catalog discovery may precede the receipt; first runtime call here means the saved launch call.

evidence: RoleFolderAndIdentityTests::test_each_role_class_gets_one_agent_in_its_folder_with_title_and_labels (the observer reads the receipt at every launch call); RepeatAndConflictTests::test_a_repeated_request_converges_on_the_same_agent ('the process ended between the receipt and the call'); l4-review/evidence/h1-…

statement: Before the first runtime call of a launch AR mints the agent id (a UUID) and creates the receipt with status `starting`, the agent id and the whole launch call; the runtime creates the agent under that id.
